name: Saturn USDat
oneLiner: USDat is Saturn's non-yield-bearing M0-backed dollar token, mintable and redeemable through KYC-gated Swap Facility flows.
collateral: 100% backed by M (M0 Protocol's tokenized short-term U.S. Treasury bills) at launch — capital is held directly in the USDat smart contract and verifiable on-chain; protocol roadmap allows reserves to shift toward digital credit instruments (e.g. Strategy STRC preferred equity) over time
pegMechanism: Permissioned 1:1 mint by depositing USDC via the M0 Swap Facility (Uniswap V3 1bps tier) which routes through wM; redemption returns USDC by unwrapping USDat back to wM and burning the USDat. Only KYC-onboarded addresses can mint, redeem, or hold USDat; geofenced away from US, EEA, and OFAC-sanctioned jurisdictions

proofOfReserves.provider: Saturn Protocol (on-chain reserve, with Accountable + Chainlink NAV oracle integration in progress)

genius.notes: Saturn documents USDaT reserve and redemption mechanics, but no public GENIUS issuer approval or registration was located. USDat is explicitly geofenced away from US and EEA users per protocol design; Saturn is BVI-domiciled with no known US regulatory registration.

mintAuthority.summary: USDat is an M0-backed extension on Ethereum; extension wrapping routes through M0 extension infrastructure while base M issuance remains on the Ethereum MinterGateway.

controls.label: M0 MinterGateway backing rail
controls.capDescription: Base M issuance backing USDat depends on approved minters, validator attestations, mint-delay review, and M0 collateral/debt checks.
controls.evidence: Official M0 deployments list the Ethereum MinterGateway, and M0 docs describe approved-minter plus validator-gated issuance.

controls.label: M0 SwapFacility extension router
controls.capDescription: SwapFacility routes approved M0 extensions 1:1 against M; it can mint extension balances through wrap flows but does not create base M supply.
controls.evidence: Official M0 deployments list SwapFacility at 0xB6807116b3B1B321a390594e31ECD6e0076f6278 on Ethereum; SwapFacility docs describe approved-extension wrap/swap routing.

review.evidence: M0 documentation describes permissioned minter/validator rails used by M0-built stablecoins.
